question: Покажи всех студентов факультета информационных технологий
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.group_name, s.course_year, sp.name AS specialization FROM students s JOIN specializations sp ON s.specialization_id = sp.id JOIN departments d ON sp.department_id = d.id JOIN faculties f ON d.faculty_id = f.id WHERE f.short_name = 'ФИТ' ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;

question: Какой средний балл по курсу Базы данных?
sql: SELECT AVG(g.score) AS average_score FROM grades g JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Базы данных' AND g.grade_type = 'экзамен';

question: Сколько студентов проживает в каждом общежитии?
sql: SELECT d.name, d.address, COUNT(da.id) AS residents FROM dormitories d LEFT JOIN dormitory_assignments da ON d.id = da.dormitory_id WHERE da.move_out_date IS NULL GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY residents DESC;

question: Покажи преподавателей, которые работают на нескольких кафедрах
sql: SELECT p.last_name, p.first_name, p.academic_degree, COUNT(pd.department_id) AS department_count FROM professors p JOIN professor_departments pd ON p.id = pd.professor_id GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(pd.department_id) > 1 ORDER BY department_count DESC;

question: Какие курсы требуют прохождения других курсов?
sql: SELECT c.name AS course, c2.name AS prerequisite FROM course_prerequisites cp JOIN courses c ON cp.course_id = c.id JOIN courses c2 ON cp.prerequisite_course_id = c2.id ORDER BY c.name;

question: Топ-5 студентов по среднему баллу за экзамены
sql: SELECT s.last_name, s.first_name, s.group_name, ROUND(AVG(g.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id = g.student_id WHERE g.grade_type = 'экзамен' GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Сколько студентов на каждом курсе по специальности Программная инженерия?
sql: SELECT s.course_year, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students s JOIN specializations sp ON s.specialization_id = sp.id WHERE sp.name = 'Программная инженерия' GROUP BY s.course_year ORDER BY s.course_year;

question: Покажи расписание занятий по кафедре кибербезопасности на понедельник
sql: SELECT c.name AS course, p.last_name AS professor, cs.room, cs.time_start, cs.time_end FROM course_schedules cs JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id JOIN professors p ON cs.professor_id = p.id JOIN departments d ON c.department_id = d.id WHERE d.name = 'Кафедра кибербезопасности' AND cs.day_of_week = 1 ORDER BY cs.time_start;

question: Какие студенты имеют академический отпуск?
sql: SELECT last_name, first_name, group_name, course_year, enrollment_date FROM students WHERE status = 'академический отпуск' ORDER BY last_name;

question: Покажи изменения оценок с указанием кто и когда изменил
sql: SELECT s.last_name, s.first_name, c.name AS course, gh.old_score, gh.new_score, gh.changed_by, gh.changed_at, gh.reason FROM grade_history gh JOIN grades g ON gh.grade_id = g.id JOIN students s ON g.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id WHERE gh.grade_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gh.changed_at DESC;

question: Какой процент студентов сдал экзамен на отлично по курсу Машинное обучение?
sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN g.score >= 90 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS excellent_percent FROM grades g JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Машинное обучение' AND g.grade_type = 'экзамен';

question: Покажи все курсы 3 семестра с указанием преподавателя и аудитории
sql: SELECT c.name AS course, c.hours, c.exam_type, p.last_name AS professor, cs.room, cs.day_of_week, cs.time_start FROM courses c JOIN course_schedules cs ON c.id = cs.course_id JOIN professors p ON cs.professor_id = p.id WHERE cs.semester = 3 ORDER BY cs.day_of_week, cs.time_start;

question: Сколько часов занятий у каждого преподавателя?
sql: SELECT p.last_name, p.first_name, SUM(c.hours) AS total_hours FROM professors p JOIN course_schedules cs ON p.id = cs.professor_id JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_hours DESC;

question: Какие студенты не зачислены ни на один курс?
sql: SELECT s.last_name, s.first_name, s.group_name FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.id = e.student_id WHERE e.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.last_name;

question: Покажи факультеты и количество кафедр на каждом
sql: SELECT f.name AS faculty, f.dean_name, COUNT(d.id) AS department_count FROM faculties f LEFT JOIN departments d ON f.id = d.faculty_id GROUP BY f.id ORDER BY department_count DESC;

question: Show students from IT faculty
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.group_name, s.course_year, sp.name AS specialization FROM students s JOIN specializations sp ON s.specialization_id = sp.id JOIN departments d ON sp.department_id = d.id JOIN faculties f ON d.faculty_id = f.id WHERE f.short_name = 'ФИТ' ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;

question: What is the average grade for Machine Learning course?
sql: SELECT AVG(g.score) AS average_score FROM grades g JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Машинное обучение' AND g.grade_type = 'экзамен';
